title: 番外 江照青1
slug: 缺爱小可怜重回爸妈十八岁那年
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

江照青还不叫江照青的时候，生活在北方的一个小镇中，疯了的妈，酒鬼的爸以及总用嫌恶眼神看他的镇民，贫穷与看不到出路的未来组成了他全部的生活。

更绝望的是，他因为路过凶案现场，被指认成了凶手，死者是曾经帮助过他的一个老师，不过如果再来一次的话，他大约还会选择停下脚步。

牢里的生活对他来说还算宁静，他以为会一直这样下去的时候，一个自称他亲生母亲的女人来见了他。

没多久，他翻案出狱了。

女人叫秦舞，她告诉他，很小的时候他被坏人拐走了，看到对方递来的资料后，他才明白原来自己是王泽英跟余温盛买来的孩子。

若是从前，他大概还会庆幸，但现在得知这个消息，他心中毫无波澜。

被亲生父母带回家后，他有了一个新的名字——江照青。

从此过往随着旧名被埋葬，无人再知晓他的过去。

“小青，虽然妈妈说过会支持你全部的决定，但这个真的是你想做的事儿吗？”

秦舞放下手中那张被江照青填过了的报名表，看向对面斜斜靠着沙发正在打哈欠的少年。

张扬漂亮的长相，姿态也恣意，但眼神却给人一种诡异的平静感，激不起任何波澜的一滩死水。

“嗯。”他应了一声。

那是某娱乐公司选秀的报名表，江照青承认自己说谎了，因为这不是自己想做的事儿，不过是走在马路上随手接过的东西。

他顺便填上了自己的信息。

做什么都无所谓，对他来说，不管什么事儿都很无聊。

做艺人很累，忙到江照青没办法想其他事。

但随着团队登顶、解散，自己转行后拿到了圈内最高奖项，他的日子又变得无聊起来。

他总是能听到很多声音，带着恶意的窃窃私语、没来由的尖叫，张狂的笑声。

最开始以为是房间里躲了私生，但让人把屋子整个清空后那些声音依旧存在，他才反应过来自己可能单纯得精神病了。

那还挺好，总比搬开床，发现下面趴着个嘴里叼着自己内裤的人强。

发现自己病了，江照青第一时间去做了检查，又把报告发给了他妈。

等秦舞赶到的时候，看到便是嘴里叼着个棒棒糖的儿子。

见她来，不紧不慢的将手里的纸飞机投过来，纸飞机晃晃悠悠停在她脚边，秦舞弯腰捡了起来展开发现那是他的检查报告。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

When Jiang Zhaoqing was not called Jiang Zhaoqing, he lived in a small town in the north. He had a crazy mother, an alcoholic father, and the townspeople who always looked at him with disgust. Poverty and a future with no way out made up his entire life.

What's even more desperate is that because he passed by the scene of the murder, he was identified as the murderer. The deceased was a teacher who had helped him, but if it happened again, he would probably choose to stop.

Life in prison was quite peaceful for him. Just when he thought it would continue like this, a woman who claimed to be his biological mother came to see him.

Not long after, he was released from prison.

The woman's name was Qin Wu. She told him that he was abducted by bad guys when he was very young. After seeing the information handed over by the other party, he realized that he was the child bought by Wang Zeying and Yu Wensheng.

In the past, he would probably have been happy, but now that he heard the news, he felt no waves in his heart.

After being brought home by his biological parents, he got a new name - Jiang Zhaoqing.

From then on, the past was buried along with his old name, and no one knew his past anymore.

"Xiao Qing, although mother said she will support all your decisions, is this really what you want to do?"

Qin Wu put down the registration form filled out by Jiang Zhaoqing and looked at the yawning boy who was leaning on the sofa opposite.

Zhang Yang has a beautiful appearance and a carefree posture, but his eyes give people a strange sense of calm, a puddle of stagnant water that cannot stir up any waves.

"Yeah." He responded.

It was a registration form for an entertainment company's talent show. Jiang Zhaoqing admitted that he had lied because it was not what he wanted to do, but it was just something he picked up casually while walking on the street.

He filled in his own information.

It doesn't matter what he does, everything is boring to him.

Being an artist is very tiring, and Jiang Zhaoqing is so busy that he can't think of anything else.

But as the team reached the top and disbanded, and he won the highest award in the industry after changing careers, his life became boring again.

He could always hear many voices, malicious whispers, unprovoked screams, and wild laughter.

At first he thought it was a bastard hiding in the room, but after having the room cleared out, the noises still existed, and he realized that he might simply be mentally ill.

That's pretty good, it's better than moving the bed and finding someone lying underneath with his underwear in his mouth.

When Jiang Zhaoqing found out that he was sick, he immediately went for a check-up and sent the report to his mother.

When Qin Wu arrived, she saw her son with a lollipop in his mouth.

Seeing her coming, he unhurriedly threw the paper airplane in his hand over. The paper airplane swayed and stopped at her feet. Qin Wu bent down, picked it up, unfolded it, and found that it was his inspection report.
